entry.title: Why first person video may matter for robot learning[D]
entry.summary: I can see why first-person video might help a robot model, but not because the robot can copy a human hand. The joints, reach, timing, and control space are all different. What may transfer is the sequence of visual attention: which object enters view, what changes before contact, and where the actor looks next.
